Grade: PP2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.1.4: Relationship
Suggested lessons in curriculum: as per KICD

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Relationship, part of Strand 4 in PP2 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.
